targets.outcome_reasoning: The results explicitly verify replication of Guo’s Frame × Time Constraint interaction. The main message is that the time-constraint manipulation also changes attention and can violate internal validity for inferring dual systems; the paper challenges that interpretation rather than denying the empirical effect. The quoted critique is the paper’s central theoretical conclusion, not a minor limitation.

reasoning: Title, DOI and three authors verified. The new participant experiment directly retests Guo et al. (2017); Experiment 1 is named in sample-size justification. Other studies primarily motivate or contextualize the mechanism. Outcome follows the special category because the replicated behavioral effect is used to argue against validity of the original dual-system inference.
